signatures.name: coherence_accuracy_psychometric
signatures.description: Accuracy increases monotonically with motion coherence (Roitman & Shadlen 2002, Fig 2). The headline psychometric signature of motion-direction discrimination.

signatures.name: coherence_rt_chronometric
signatures.description: Correct RT decreases as coherence increases (Roitman & Shadlen 2002 chronometric function).

signatures.name: above_chance_low_coherence
signatures.description: Accuracy at the lowest non-zero coherence (5%) remains significantly above chance (0.5).

signatures.name: above_chance_overall
signatures.description: Overall accuracy across all coherences is significantly above chance.
